description: Somos un equipo de desarrollo de proyectos digitales con experiencia en desarrollo de videojuegos, páginas web y producción cinematográfica. Tenemos un amplio repertorio de habilidades técnicas, pero nuestra principal característica es el trabajo duro y la perseverancia. Estamos en una constante búsqueda de nuevos retos y aventuras, por lo que este evento nos resulta una gran oportunidad para probar que en Honduras podemos hacer proyectos artísticos de alta calidad libres de IA.
summary:
We are developing a resource management and survival game where every decision has consequences. The player takes on the role of an astronaut sent to Mars to establish a sustainable human outpost. However, upon arrival, they discover that critical spacecraft systems, including communications and power infrastructure, have malfunctioned.

The first challenge is to restore electricity by deploying solar panels, allowing the astronaut to power essential outpost systems. From there, players must explore the Martian environment, collect resources, and progressively improve their living conditions and infrastructure. As the mission advances, they can build greenhouses to grow crops, deploy scientific instruments, and develop technologies that support long-term survival and scientific research.

Our goal is to create an engaging educational experience that teaches players the importance of strategic decision-making, resource management, and sustainability. Through interactive gameplay, players will explore simplified scientific concepts such as renewable energy, agriculture in extreme environments, resource conservation, and space exploration.

We believe this experience can inspire children and people of all ages to learn through experimentation while imagining a future where humanity expands beyond Earth and establishes a sustainable presence on another planet.
details:
Project Details

Our project is an interactive resource management and survival game that simulates the challenges of establishing a sustainable human outpost on Mars. Players take the role of an astronaut who must overcome unexpected spacecraft failures, restore essential systems, and gradually develop a functional Martian settlement.

The gameplay revolves around exploration, resource collection, energy management, construction, and strategic decision-making. Players must prioritize their needs, deploy solar panels to generate electricity, gather resources from the Martian environment, build greenhouses to produce food, and install scientific equipment to study the planet. Every decision affects the astronaut's survival and the outpost's development.

The main benefit of our project is its educational approach. Instead of simply presenting scientific information, the game encourages players to learn through interaction and experimentation. It introduces concepts such as renewable energy, sustainability, resource conservation, space exploration, and the challenges of living in extreme environments.

Our intended impact is to make space science more accessible and engaging for children and people of all ages, encouraging critical thinking, problem-solving, and curiosity about humanity's future beyond Earth.

The creative aspect of our project lies in combining survival mechanics with simplified scientific concepts, transforming complex challenges of real space missions into interactive gameplay experiences. During development, we considered scientific plausibility, gameplay accessibility, resource limitations, player progression, and the importance of making decisions meaningful and educational.
